goal: A3 authenticated Codex session lifecycle integration
scope: A-owned runtime integration only; no live provider turn, delivery, workshop, or capture
implementation: Host configuration is disabled by default and requires explicit Codex enablement, consent, executable, model, effort, time/token bounds, and a separate state directory.

The authenticated system.codex.refresh command is the only path that invokes agent.capabilities. It caches sanitized readiness for ten minutes against a host configuration fingerprint; ordinary status/capability reads launch no provider process.

Fresh host-configured model/effort catalog verification is reported separately from execution readiness. Catalog status requires a fresh timezone-aware record, matching configuration fingerprint, matching verified model and effort, and a ChatGPT account; coding and job.run still require usd_cost_enforced:true, host consent, policy, and positive reservation.

The snapshot publishes host_enabled and each project's known action grants. The explicit project.enable_coding command adds only propose_patch under fresh full readiness, consent, and non-stopped runtime gates; replay is idempotent and existing policy fields are preserved.

Dispatch additionally requires the provider's explicit usd_cost_enforced:true capability. Absent or false is sanitized to unavailable, so native Codex currently cannot dispatch even if model, effort, account, consent, policy, and reservation checks pass.

Only a canonical stored typed-source build profile with read_repo/propose_patch/run_checks, candidate.frozen_identity, a bounded write scope, verified USD ceiling, and positive budget can dispatch. Public execution_profile is host-derived. job.resume requires fresh readiness, current source identity, uncertain positive reservation, and the same persisted provider thread.

Typed thread/turn progress is request-bound, sequence-checked, bounded, persisted before a generic public event, and never exposes provider IDs to renderer-facing events. Startup interruption becomes ambiguous; no automatic retry creates a replacement turn.

The scheduler connects B repo inspection/preparation and agent.execute to frozen candidate import and D frozen-identity verification. Candidate files and linked artifacts are hash-checked into runtime-owned storage. Unknown provider USD cost stays NULL/uncertain and the reservation remains held.
